text:
Mina: quick ping — PR 48921 updates eviction fallback and routing heuristics, touches runtime eviction controller + platform routing. CI passed but need runtime/infra/security eyes before canary/merge. TL;DR: lower mem_threshold from 0.75 -> 0.65, add cheap-model fallback for batch overflow, canary flag `orch.fallback_canary=true`.
Diego: linking to PR? can you paste the diff or files changed? I want to check eviction backoff logic.
Mina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/48921
Files: runtime/service/evict.go, platform/orch/routing.go, infra/kms_masking.md (new note). small change in runtime tests.
Ava: I can take sec eyes. we need to ensure KMS usage is not leaking any ARNs to logs and add a unit test for masked logs. also, add a note about HSM key policy. :shield:
Ran: runtime - I can look at evict.go. Quick question — is `cheap-model` a quantized variant or a separate model family? Need perf numbers for 512 token tails.
Mina: cheap-model is `rw-small-quant` (int8). Perf: 12ms/token on p4d with batching; with fallback we expect 10-15% tail latency improvement. Added benchmark csv to PR.
Diego: I see an edge case in backoff: if mem_threshold triggers during a long-running batch, KV cache flush path might race. Can we add a short sleep/backoff here? I'll post a tiny patch in comments.
Mina: yep, welcome. I've added a test that simulates concurrent eviction and batch flush.
Ava: also need audit log entry for routing fallback decision — please add an event: orch.fallback.reason=eviction_pressure
Mina: added event line in platform/orch/routing.go (see PR).
deploy-bot: CI build 48921 — all checks passed. staging deploy scheduled at 2025-02-12T18:00:00Z for canary.
Ran: I can sign off on runtime changes after Diego's tiny patch and CI rerun.
Diego: pushed patch for backoff +- small comment. rerunning tests now.
deploy-bot: CI re-run success.
Ava: security ok with masked logs/HSM note. ack from sec.
Diego: LGTM from me — no runtime regressions in my quick run.
Mina: thank you all! requesting merge window next Tue 10:00 PST if ops can take it. tagging @ops for merge slot.
ops-bot: merge window request received; added to Tuesday 10:00 PST slot. :white_check_mark:
Mina: great, I'll queue the canary, and notify stakeholders.
